nodes.title: /pricing shows three plan cards, Set-up (free), One child (PRICES.monthly) and Brother or sister (PRICES.sibling), all built from src/app/site.ts PLANS. There is no payment step: every action is the free set-up, a TBD price reads 'Not set yet' on its card, and a callout says paying is not open and no card is asked for. The cards list only what the product does today; cancellation is described as future, never as a feature. Linked from the site header, the footer and the landing's price section. Reverse: the owner chooses a payment provider (then a checkout seam from Platform), or renames or drops a plan in PLANS.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-pricing-page`
The owner's prices drop into one file, and the plan cards, the landing line and the header link all follow. Until then the page is honest: set-up is free, lesson prices are not set, and nothing can be paid.
